page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-32-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance featuring 32 dedicated virtual CPUs and 124.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a resource density of approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per vCPU core. The instance operates without integrated GPU hardware accelerators and does not include allocated local storage.

With its balanced allocation of compute and memory resources, this instance type is designed for general-purpose workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core environments. This hardware profile is suited for applications such as web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and moderate database workloads that require a stable balance of processing power and memory capacity.
